title: The Passholder Share Taken Off an Equipment Rental and Demo Hire Rate
content:
A rider who carries one of the collective's season passes and uses it hires kit of the Equipment Rental and Demo line on better terms than a rider who does not, and how much better follows how often the pass has been scanned.

## The rule

Where the rider holds a Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season, and the pass account carries at least 6 lift scans in the three months before the hire rate is raised, the package's passholder share is taken in full.

Where the rider holds a Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season and the pass account carries fewer than 6 lift scans in those three months, half the package's passholder share is taken.

In any other case no share is taken off under this heading.

## The package figures this rule reads

| Package | Passholder share | Half of it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 10 per cent | 5 per cent |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 15 per cent | 7.5 per cent |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 20 per cent | 10 per cent |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 20 per cent | 10 per cent |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 25 per cent | 12.5 per cent |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 30 per cent | 15 per cent |

## The conditions in combination

| Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season | Lift scans on the pass account in the three months before the hire rate is raised | Share taken off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 6 or more | the package's passholder share in full |
| yes | 5 or fewer | half the package's passholder share |
| no pass, or a pass not standing active | not counted | none under this heading |

The scan count of 6 is met by 6 scans and not by 5, and the window is the three months running back from the day the hire rate is raised.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical agreement

Take a Sport Ski & Board Rental agreement whose days at the day rate come to 265.00 USD.

- The rider's pass stands active for the season and the pass account shows 11 lift scans inside the three months: 20 per cent is taken off, leaving 212.00 USD.
- The rider's pass stands active for the season and the pass account shows 2 lift scans inside the three months: 10 per cent is taken off, leaving 238.50 USD.
- The rider holds no pass standing active for the season: no share is taken off under this heading.

## Point of judgement

**Whose pass is read.** The pass read is one held by the rider on the agreement, standing active for the season the agreement belongs to.
